comment: Player-character portraits (80x100, head and shoulders, re-crushed from the 256x320 seed-42 raws via dev/pixel-art/recrush_pc.py) and 8x8 class icons. Frame _b is an eye_pulse of _a (eyes brighten one palette step). Material conventions: skin 13 base / 12 shadow, hair 9, garment primary 15, garment secondary 10, outline 1, eyes 2 or 20. Race variants remap those indices.
